preconditions.description: Number of testcases T is between 1 and 4000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: Length of each string N is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) == N for N, S in zip(Ns, Ss))
preconditions.description: Each string S has a length equal to the corresponding N.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '01' for c in S) for S in Ss)
preconditions.description: Each string S consists only of characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of testcases T.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, int) for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result <= N for result in output)
postconditions.description: Each result is between 0 and the length of the corresponding string N.

postconditions.expression: all(result == max_count_01(S) for result, S in zip(output, Ss))
postconditions.description: Each result is the maximum number of occurrences of '01' as a substring in the corresponding string S after performing the allowed swaps.
